mapper.insert: INSERT INTO px_analytics_event(event_id,visitor_id,session_id,page_view_id,event_name,page_key,content_id,target_id,operation_id,referrer_host,user_id,duration_ms,occurred_at) VALUES(#{eventId},#{visitorId},#{sessionId},#{pageViewId},#{eventName},#{pageKey},#{contentId},#{targetId},#{operationId},#{referrerHost},#{userId},#{durationMs},#{eventTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id=event_id
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(event_name='page_view'),0) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(duration_ms),0) AS durationMs FROM px_analytics_event

SELECT page_key AS pageKey,content_id AS contentId, CASE WHEN page_key='post_detail' THEN (SELECT a.title FROM px_article a WHERE a.id=content_id) WHEN page_key='video_detail' THEN (SELECT v.title FROM px_video v WHERE v.id=content_id) ELSE NULL END AS contentTitle, SUM(event_name='page_view') AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS uv, SUM(duration_ms) AS durationMs, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name='read_100' THEN page_view_id END) AS reachedEnd FROM px_analytics_event GROUP BY page_key,content_id ORDER BY pv DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT event_name AS eventName,COUNT(*) AS total,COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS uv FROM px_analytics_event AND event_name NOT IN ('page_view','page_duration') GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT event_id AS eventId,visitor_id AS visitorId,session_id AS sessionId,page_view_id AS pageViewId, event_name AS eventName,page_key AS pageKey,content_id AS contentId,target_id AS targetId,operation_id AS operationId, duration_ms AS durationMs,DATE_FORMAT(occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurredAt FROM px_analytics_event ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC

SELECT feature, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(successTime IS NOT NULL AND successTime >= submitTime) AS successes, SUM(failTime IS NOT NULL AND failTime >= submitTime) AS failures, SUM(stopTime IS NOT NULL AND stopTime >= submitTime) AS stops FROM ( SELECT visitor_id,session_id,operation_id,SUBSTRING_INDEX(event_name,'_',1) AS feature, MIN(CASE WHEN event_name LIKE '%_submit' THEN occurred_at END) AS submitTime, MIN(CASE WHEN event_name LIKE '%_success' THEN occurred_at END) AS successTime, MIN(CASE WHEN event_name LIKE '%_fail' THEN occurred_at END) AS failTime, MIN(CASE WHEN event_name='ai_stop' THEN occurred_at END) AS stopTime FROM px_analytics_event AND operation_id IS NOT NULL AND event_name IN ('register_submit','register_success','register_fail','activation_submit','activation_success','activation_fail','login_submit','login_success','login_fail','reply_submit','reply_success','reply_fail','search_submit','search_success','search_fail','comment_submit','comment_success','comment_fail','ai_submit','ai_success','ai_fail','ai_stop') GROUP BY visitor_id,session_id,operation_id,SUBSTRING_INDEX(event_name,'_',1) ) operations WHERE submitTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY feature

SELECT visitor_id AS visitorId,session_id AS sessionId,page_view_id AS pageViewId, operation_id AS operationId,event_name AS eventName,page_key AS pageKey, DATE_FORMAT(occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS time FROM px_analytics_event AND event_name IN ('search_submit','search_success','search_click','read_50','comment_submit','comment_success','ai_open','ai_submit','ai_success') ORDER BY occurred_at,id LIMIT 20001
